Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1214
Claimant:
Jacob Hernandez
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
2024-08-26
Claim opened after a side impact at an intersection involving the insured's vehicle and a second vehicle. The claimant
reoprts neck strain and is not represented by an attorney.
2024-10-19
Confirmed the driver is named on the policy and that the policy was in force at the time of loss. No concerns with
coverage identification at this stage.
2024-11-20
Obtained the police report, which places the claimant inside the vehicle at impact and records the collision as
described by the claimant.
2024-11-25
Spoke with the other driver, who gave an account matching the claimant's description of how the crash occurred.
Photos from the scene are consistent with a side impact at the intersection.
2024-12-06
Took a recorded statement from the claimant. The account of the collision was the same as the one given at first
notice of loss.
2025-01-10
Reviewed the injury report. The neck strain fits the direction and force of the impact. No prior treatment to the neck or
upper back appears in available records.
2025-01-13
Inspected the vehicle and noted damage to the driver's side. Prior inspection records show no earlier damage to this
vehicle. Some of the visible damage may have come from a different source, so the extent attributable to this impact
has not been settled.
2025-02-10
Treatment has continued somewhat longer than is typical for a strain of this type. Requested updated treatment notes
to review the course of care.
2025-03-19
Spoke with the claimant again. The account has stayed consistent across every contact. Nothing in the file suggests
the damage predates the coverage period. Will continue reviewing the treatment records and the vehicle damage
estimate before deciding next steps.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
